messages.content: {"ok": true, "sections": [{"citation": "refund-policy/v1/return", "title": "Items must be returned first", "text": "The shop refunds only units it has received back, as shown by its own return records, never by a statement of the customer or the assistant. If the records show the units arrived, the request continues normally. If they do not, the shop pays nothing for those units; if the customer says the units were already sent, a staff member checks."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/window", "title": "Time limit", "text": "A refund must be requested no later than 30 days after the delivery time recorded on the order. Days are exact periods of twenty-four hours, and a request at exactly the deadline is on time. The request time is the moment the shop creates the refund proposal. If an earlier proposal for the same items was created in time but expired or stopped being valid before it was paid, a later request is not refused for being late: a staff member takes the case."}, {"citation": "refund-policy/v1/amount", "title": "Refund amount", "text": "The refund for a unit is what was paid for that unit: its price minus its share of any discount. The shares are fixed once, when the order is recorded, and never recalculated: when a paid total is split among identical units, each unit gets the total divided by the number of units, rounded down to the smallest unit of the currency, and what is left over is added one smallest unit at a time to the last units, so no unit is refunded more than its price. Shipping charges are not part of the amount."}], "note": "Cite a section by its citation ID, exactly as given."}
